scope_clarifications: The seven diagnostic records are dictionary references, not new instructional milestones; only dīcas also occurs as a worked pronunciation form.
The three subject aliases reuse existing dictionary headings and broad definitions for access while preserving explicitly nominative subject meaning; they do not promote later obliques.

English access lists can include supplied and context-only senses for lookup completeness. Independent assessment remains governed by the actual task and the accepted per-use Unit 1 contract, not by dictionary inclusion.
All 25 pronunciation tasks supply forms and meanings; their empty English-production route lists are explicit current sound-only dispositions.
Old exhaustive form routes remain in data. The printed dictionary continues to group forms under lemmas with selective opaque-form pointers.
